tests.name: NtfsAttributeList
tests.discoveredOn: P0-7: real-disk MFT record 78 had 56725784 bytes in $ATTRIBUTE_LIST extension records but engine reported clusterCount=0

RecoverEngine::RecoverBatch writes the exact 1500 payload bytes
extension records without $FILE_NAME must not become nodes
negative guard omits $ATTRIBUTE_LIST -> cluster/byte gates MUST fail
